REVISION / INTERVIEW ANSWERS
Quick memory revision

01. Database vs DBMS vs RDBMS
An RDBMS is a DBMS based on the relational model.

02. Tables, rows and columns
One record in a table.

03. Primary, foreign, unique and composite keys
No, but one primary key can contain multiple columns.

04. NOT NULL, CHECK and DEFAULT
The database protects integrity regardless of the client.

05. Relationships: 1:1, 1:N, N:M
Use a junction table containing foreign keys to both
parent tables.

06. ER diagrams
The allowed number of related instances between
entities.

07. Normalization: 1NF, 2NF, 3NF
To reduce redundancy and insertion, update and
deletion anomalies.

08. Denormalization
No. Measure reads, writes and maintenance costs.

09. DDL, DML, DQL, DCL and TCL
DDL because it removes a schema object.

10. SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
All rows may be updated.

11. WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT
It makes ties deterministic when paging.

12. DISTINCT
No, it changes only the result.

13. LIKE, IN, BETWEEN, IS NULL
Use IS NULL, not = NULL.

14. Aggregate functions
COUNT(*) counts rows, COUNT(column) ignores NULLs.

15. GROUP BY and HAVING
No, use HAVING or a subquery.

16. INNER, LEFT, RIGHT and CROSS JOIN
The join returns two matching pairs for that customer.

17. FULL OUTER JOIN concept (MySQL workaround)
Preserves genuine duplicate pairs without repeating
matches.
